name: The Adventurer
summary: In Teldrassil, a lost journal waits to be carried to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar. Its pages record an unknown traveler's simple journeys and camping outings.

sections.title: A Wanderer's Journal
sections.body: You find a journal among Teldrassil's boughs and roots. Its nameless writer records modest wanderings and the simple pleasure of making camp beneath the twilight canopy.

sections.title: Delivery to Dolanaar
sections.body: The journal can be carried toward Dolanaar instead of left in the wilderness. Lyreena Duskblade waits near the night elf settlement to receive the lost pages.

faq.q: What is the journal mentioned in the quest?
faq.answer: The journal is a plain notebook found in Teldrassil's wilds. Its entries tell of an unknown traveler's quiet journeys and fondness for camping outdoors.
Lyreena Duskblade is a night elf near Dolanaar, and the lost journal is meant for her.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: The story takes place in Teldrassil, in the wilderness around Dolanaar.

faq.q: Does the journal describe dangerous monsters or battles?
faq.answer: No. The journal tells of an unknown person's ordinary wanderings and enjoyment of camping, not dangerous monsters or battles.
Alliance members exploring Teldrassil, especially novice night elves near Dolanaar, can complete it.

faq.q: Why turn the journal in to Dolanaar?
faq.answer: Dolanaar is a central gathering place and crossroads in this part of Teldrassil. Lyreena Duskblade waits nearby to receive the journal.

angles.text: As a young night elf patrolling Teldrassil, you may find signs of travelers and carry lost keepsakes to wanderers like Lyreena Duskblade.
As an Alliance novice beneath the World Tree, you help keep the groves in order by returning lost belongings to fellow travelers.
